description: Team and sharing settings of the connected workspace. operation: list_team; invite_member (args {email}) and remove_member (args {member: user id from list_team}) for the owner only; list_client_pages, create_client_page (args {name, charts: [chart ids]}) and delete_client_page (args {id}) for read-only pages to share with clients; list_domains, add_domain (args {host, page: client page id}), verify_domain and remove_domain (args {host}) for a custom domain (Team or Business owner). remove_member, delete_client_page and remove_domain cannot be undone. Returns the result as JSON. Needs a connection signed in to a free account (connector URL ending in /mcp/account).

args.description: Arguments for the operation, e.g. {"email":"ana@example.com"}; {} for list operations.

operation.description: What to do; see the description for each operation's args.
